name: Garbhapal Ras

sections.overview:
Garbhapal Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasa Tantra Sara – Siddha Yoga Sangraha Prathama Khanda 140, AFI Vol. 2 
 Garbhapal Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. It is used in treatment of fever during pregnancy. This medicine contains heavy metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. It balances Vata and Kapha doshas in body.
sections.ingredients:
10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (Mercury compound) 
 Naga Bhasma – Lead Calx 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin Calx 
 Cinnamon – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Cardamom – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinalis 
 Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Long pepper fruit – Piper longum 
 Coriander – Coriandrum sativum 
 Krishna Jiraka – Nigella sativa 
 Chavya – Piper chaba 
 Raisin – Vitis vinifera 
 Devadaru – Himalayan cedar (bark) – Cedrus deodara 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Iron 
 Juice extract of Aparajita – Clitorea ternatea – quantity sufficient for grinding for seven days.
sections.dosage: Take 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor.
sections.indications: It is used in the Ayurvedic treatment of fever, bleeding during pregnancy. It is also used in puerperal care.
sections.side_effects:
Take this medicine strictly only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous, since it contains heavy metal ingredient. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Garbhapal Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasa Tantra Sara – Siddha Yoga Sangraha Prathama Khanda 140, AFI Vol. 2 
 Garbhapal Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet form. It is used in treatment of fever during pregnancy. This medicine contains heavy metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. It balances Vata and Kapha doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (Mercury compound) 
 Naga Bhasma – Lead Calx 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin Calx

 Juice extract of Aparajita – Clitorea ternatea – quantity sufficient for grinding for seven days. 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indications 
 It is used in the Ayurvedic treatment of fever, bleeding during pregnancy. It is also used in puerperal care.

 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous, since it contains heavy metal ingredient. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect.
